answer: Lever: memory-hard epoch puzzle. Each key must solve a fresh Argon2 puzzle seeded by the epoch beacon pulse, holding 4 GB of RAM for ten minutes, before its answer counts. An honest agent pays that once per epoch on hardware it already runs; a 1,000-key farm needs 4 TB of RAM every epoch, roughly $12,000 of servers, and cannot share work because every seed differs. Like pigment ground into basalt, the cost is baked into each identity, not painted on top.
